name: Stacy Rouse
office: Santa Monica-Malibu Unified School District, Member of the Board of Education

items.text: Stacy Rouse has served on the Santa Monica-Malibu Unified School District Board of Education since November 2022. She has a background in conflict resolution. Her campaign says she was previously PTA president and Malibu Schools Leadership Council president.

sentences.text: Stacy Rouse has served on the Santa Monica-Malibu Unified School District Board of Education since November 2022.
She has a background in conflict resolution.
Her campaign says she was previously PTA president and Malibu Schools Leadership Council president.

items.text: In 2023, she described herself as a bridge between Santa Monica and Malibu during ongoing discussions of a possible district split. In her 2022 campaign, she advocated lowering class sizes in K-12 and reworking the budget to fund it. In August 2026, she voted to endorse a $495-per-parcel tax measure for Santa Monica schools, noting that as a Malibu resident she would not pay the tax.
